model.name: gemma-2-9b
model.about: Google Gemma 2 9B instruct (June 2024), BF16, from Unsloth's ungated copy of Google's weights (google/gemma-2-9b-it is gated; same weights, Gemma licence). Gemma 2's own chat template refuses a system message, which every request of the app carries, so the profile serves it with the same template except that the system text opens the first user turn, as Google's Gemma 3 template does. Context is 8,192 tokens, the model's own limit. Free whitespace is disallowed in the JSON grammar: with vLLM's default, it padded finished answers until the token limit (the first run, 2026-09-27, stopped early on 21 cut-off replies), as EuroLLM did.

answers.sql:
SELECT  
    dc.display_name AS channel_name, 
    COUNT(fact_at.account_transaction_fact_key) AS transaction_count 
FROM bank_dwh.fact_account_transaction fact_at 
JOIN bank_dwh.dim_channel dc ON fact_at.channel_key = dc.channel_key 
WHERE fact_at.business_date_key IN (SELECT date_key FROM bank_dwh.dim_date WHERE calendar_year_number = 2025) 
GROUP BY dc.display_name 
ORDER BY transaction_count DESC;
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT dim_customer.business_id) FROM bank_dwh.dim_customer WHERE dim_customer.is_current = TRUE AND dim_customer.is_active = TRUE

SELECT  
    d.calendar_date AS business_date, 
    j.display_name AS jurisdiction, 
    COUNT(DISTINCT fa.aml_alert_fact_key) AS alert_count 
FROM bank_dwh.fact_aml_alert fa 
JOIN bank_dwh.dim_jurisdiction j ON fa.jurisdiction_key = j.jurisdiction_key 
JOIN bank_dwh.dim_date d ON fa.business_date_key = d.date_key 
WHERE d.calendar_date BETWEEN '2025-01-01' AND '2025-12-31' 
GROUP BY 1, 2 
ORDER BY 1, 2;

SELECT
  b.display_name AS branch_name,
  COUNT(DISTINCT fact_atm_transaction.atm_transaction_fact_key) AS transaction_count
FROM bank_dwh.fact_atm_transaction
JOIN bank_dwh.dim_branch b ON fact_atm_transaction.branch_key = b.branch_key
JOIN bank_dwh.dim_date d ON fact_atm_transaction.business_date_key = d.date_key
WHERE d.calendar_year = 2025
GROUP BY b.display_name
ORDER BY transaction_count DESC;
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM bank_dwh.fact_card_dispute WHERE business_date_key IN (SELECT date_key FROM bank_dwh.dim_date WHERE calendar_year_number = 2025)

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.business_id) AS clients_in_default
FROM bank_dwh.fact_loan_delinquency_daily AS f
JOIN bank_dwh.dim_date AS d ON d.date_key = f.business_date_key
JOIN bank_dwh.dim_customer AS c ON c.customer_key = f.customer_key
WHERE f.default_flag = TRUE
  AND d.calendar_date = (
    SELECT MAX(snapshot_day.calendar_date)
    FROM bank_dwh.fact_loan_delinquency_daily AS snapshot_fact
    JOIN bank_dwh.dim_date AS snapshot_day ON snapshot_day.date_key = snapshot_fact.business_date_key
    WHERE snapshot_day.calendar_year_number = 2025
      AND snapshot_day.month_number = 8
  );

SELECT
  c.display_name AS complaint_category,
  COUNT(*) AS complaint_count
FROM bank_dwh.fact_complaint fc
JOIN bank_dwh.dim_complaint_category c ON fc.complaint_category_key = c.complaint_category_key
JOIN bank_dwh.dim_date d ON fc.business_date_key = d.date_key
WHERE d.calendar_year = 2025
GROUP BY c.display_name;

SELECT
  c.currency_code,
  AVG(fxr.mid_rate)
FROM
  bank_dwh.fact_fx_rate_daily fxr
JOIN
  bank_dwh.dim_currency c ON fxr.currency_key = c.currency_key
WHERE
  fxr.business_date_key IN (SELECT date_key FROM bank_dwh.dim_date WHERE calendar_year_number = 2025)
GROUP BY
  c.currency_code;

SELECT
  d.calendar_date AS valuation_date,
  m.display_name AS market_name,
  SUM(fpv.market_value_amount) AS total_market_value
FROM bank_dwh.fact_portfolio_valuation_daily fpv
JOIN bank_dwh.dim_portfolio p ON fpv.portfolio_key = p.portfolio_key
JOIN bank_dwh.dim_market m ON fpv.market_key = m.market_key
JOIN bank_dwh.dim_date d ON fpv.business_date_key = d.date_key
WHERE d.calendar_date BETWEEN '2025-01-01' AND '2025-12-31'
GROUP BY 1, 2
ORDER BY 1, 2;
DELETE FROM bank_dwh.dim_customer WHERE customer_key IN (SELECT customer_key FROM bank_dwh.dim_customer GROUP BY customer_key HAVING COUNT(*) > 1) ;
SELECT  dim_account.account_type_code, COUNT(*) AS num_accounts FROM bank_dwh.dim_account WHERE dim_account.opened_date BETWEEN '2025-01-01' AND '2025-12-31' GROUP BY dim_account.account_type_code;

SELECT
  dbr.city_name,
  COUNT(fact_atm_transaction.atm_transaction_fact_key) AS transaction_count
FROM bank_dwh.fact_atm_transaction
JOIN bank_dwh.dim_branch dbr ON fact_atm_transaction.branch_key = dbr.branch_key
JOIN bank_dwh.dim_date ddt ON fact_atm_transaction.business_date_key = ddt.date_key
WHERE ddt.quarter_number = 1
GROUP BY dbr.city_name
ORDER BY dbr.city_name;
SELECT AVG(closing_balance_amount) FROM bank_dwh.fact_account_balance_daily WHERE business_date_key = (SELECT date_key FROM bank_dwh.dim_date WHERE calendar_date = '2025-06-30')

SELECT f.mid_rate FROM bank_dwh.fact_fx_rate_daily f JOIN bank_dwh.dim_date d ON f.business_date_key = d.date_key WHERE d.calendar_date BETWEEN '2025-12-01' AND '2025-12-31' AND f.currency_code = 'USD' GROUP BY f.mid_rate

SELECT

FROM
  bank_dwh.dim_customer c

GROUP BY
  c.customer_key
ORDER BY
  c.customer_key;

SELECT
  c.customer_segment_code,
  AVG(fci.transaction_amount) AS average_customer_lifetime_value
FROM bank_dwh.dim_customer c
JOIN bank_dwh.fact_customer_interaction fci ON c.customer_key = fci.customer_key
GROUP BY c.customer_segment_code;

SELECT
  db.display_name AS branch_name,
  AVG(fabd.average_balance_amount)
FROM bank_dwh.dim_branch db
JOIN bank_dwh.fact_account_balance_daily fabd ON db.branch_key = fabd.branch_key
GROUP BY db.display_name;

SELECT
  fca.corporate_action_fact_key,
  fca.business_date_key,
  fca.customer_key,
  dc.display_name AS customer_name,
  fca.security_key,
  fca.instrument_type_key,
  fca.market_key,
  fca.currency_key,
  dc.currency_code
FROM bank_dwh.fact_corporate_action fca
JOIN bank_dwh.dim_customer dc ON fca.customer_key = dc.customer_key
JOIN bank_dwh.dim_currency dc2 ON fca.currency_key = dc2.currency_key
WHERE dc.is_active = TRUE
  AND dc2.is_current = TRUE;

SELECT

GROUP BY d.display_name;

FROM bank_dwh.dim_date
WHERE bank_dwh.dim_date.calendar_year_number = 2025;

GROUP BY d.display_name;

SELECT
  fca.corporate_action_fact_key,
  fca.business_date_key,
  fca.customer_key,
  dc.display_name AS customer_name,
  fca.instrument_type_key,
  fca.market_key,
  fca.currency_key,
  dc.currency_symbol
FROM bank_dwh.fact_corporate_action fca
JOIN bank_dwh.dim_customer dc ON fca.customer_key = dc.customer_key
JOIN bank_dwh.dim_currency dc2 ON fca.currency_key = dc2.currency_key
WHERE 1=1
ORDER BY fca.business_date_key, dc.display_name;

SELECT
  d.display_name AS customer_name,
  COUNT(CASE WHEN d.gender = 'Male' THEN 1 END) AS male_count,
  COUNT(CASE WHEN d.gender = 'Female' THEN 1 END) AS female_count
FROM bank_dwh.dim_customer d
GROUP BY d.display_name
ORDER BY d.display_name;

SELECT
  AVG(CASE WHEN  
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM bank_dwh.fact_account_balance_daily WHERE fact_account_balance_daily.business_date_key = bank_dwh.dim_date.date_key AND fact_account_balance_daily.customer_key = bank_dwh.fact_overdraft_usage_daily.customer_key) > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS net_promoter_score
FROM bank_dwh.fact_overdraft_usage_daily
JOIN bank_dwh.dim_date ON bank_dwh.fact_overdraft_usage_daily.business_date_key = bank_dwh.dim_date.date_key
WHERE bank_dwh.dim_date.calendar_year_number = 2025
DELETE FROM bank_dwh.dim_customer WHERE customer_key IN (SELECT customer_key FROM bank_dwh.dim_customer GROUP BY customer_key HAVING COUNT(*) > 1) ;
DROP TABLE bank_dwh.fact_complaint;
SELECT DISTINCT b.display_name AS branch_name FROM bank_dwh.fact_aml_alert a JOIN bank_dwh.dim_branch b ON a.branch_key = b.branch_key  TRUNCATE TABLE bank_dwh.fact_aml_alert;

INSERT INTO bank_dwh.fact_fx_rate_daily (fx_rate_daily_fact_key, business_date_key, currency_code, base_currency_code, quote_currency_code, mid_rate) VALUES (nextval('bank_dwh.fact_fx_rate_daily_fx_rate_daily_fact_key_seq'), (SELECT date_key FROM bank_dwh.dim_date WHERE calendar_date = '2025-12-31'), 'USD', 'USD', 'USD', 1.10);
UPDATE bank_dwh.dim_customer SET customer_segment_code = 'AFFLUENT' WHERE city_name = 'Cluj-Napoca';

SELECT  
    c.currency_code,
    SUM(wt.amount) AS total_wire_transfer_volume
FROM bank_dwh.fact_wire_transfer wt
JOIN bank_dwh.dim_currency c ON wt.currency_key = c.currency_key
WHERE wt.business_date_key IN (SELECT date_key FROM bank_dwh.dim_date WHERE calendar_year_number = 2025)
GROUP BY c.currency_code;
